messages:
Nina (product): Quick thread  on tightening the playground chat action cluster. Focus: streaming indicator placement, single action pill (stop/regenerate), tiny token counter, and prompt picker access. Figma: https://figma.com/s/pg-chat-compact 

Omar (design): Proposed: compact inline bar under input. Left token microchip, center action pill, right prompt button. Action pill toggles state; long-press or chevron opens secondary actions (Stop & keep, Regenerate now).

Leah (eng): Prefer single pill for simpler events. Backend will emit `streamState` + `tokens`. Debounce client regen clicks 300ms. Queue prompt applies if stream active.

Sam (a11y): Keyboard parity required (Enter=stop, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter=regen). Token chip needs sr-only text like "Tokens used: 124 of 4096" and aria-live updates. Focus ring and contrast checks for the stop state.

Preview Bot: preview at https://preview.redwood/dev/pg-compact/1773500001 (screenshot attached).

Nina (product): Action items: Omar update mock with separate pulse indicator (no layout shift), Leah add event schema + debounce, Sam deliver a concise a11y checklist. Back tomorrow.
